title: Quests in the woods
content: I am constantly going on quests in the woods. Sometimes there is an abandoned carnival at the entrance. There is always a river. These quests range from scavenger hunts to survival games. Depending on the night I could be with family members, friends, strangers or by myself against others. I’m not sure what the goal is but there is definitely a point to all this. I just don’t know what it is.
